$comment: Machine-readable index of the skills installable from this repo's Claude Code plugin marketplace. Keep entries in sync with .claude-plugin/marketplace.json and with the site catalog in src/data/skills.ts. External consumers read this file raw from GitHub (Kotrain's skills shelf). Curated external skills are catalogued on the site itself (link-only), not here.

skills.name: Domain Finder
skills.description: Brainstorm startup/project names, check domain availability across TLDs via RDAP, and vet brand/trademark conflicts.
skills.author: Nekko Labs

skills.name: Resume Checker
skills.description: Check a resume against automated candidate-screening (ATS) signals and AI-centric job expectations, score it against specific job postings, then interactively apply fixes and show exactly what changed.
skills.author: Nekko Labs

skills.name: codereview-spec
skills.description: Reviews a change against your spec, and reviews the spec itself. Catches code the spec never promised, features shipped without a spec update, and the gaps in the spec that let them through.
skills.author: Nekko Labs

skills.name: nyaa
skills.description: Five reviewer cats read your PR or working diff, one lens each: spec conformance, security, dependencies, correctness, and style. Choose which cats sit, and external bot reviews fold into a single verdict.
skills.author: Nekko Labs
